prov:action:
#########
# GDSC ETL is performed in two steps: shell script to ETL data into postgres
# and then additional transformations with SQL in postGIS (if needed).
####

#########
# Step 1 - bash script (pseudo code)
####

# create directory structure and move into it
mkdir -p /data/mdc_county_park_boundaries/download -p /data/mdc_county_park_boundaries/etl
chmod -R 777 /data/mdc_county_park_boundaries
cd /data/mdc_county_park_boundaries

# set update flag based on last update and update frequency
do_update=0 if date() < last_update + update_frequency else do_update = 1

# download if update flag is set:
if do_update == 1 then
wget --retry-connrefused --waitretry=1 --read-timeout=20 --timeout=15 -t 10 -O download/mdc_county_park_boundaries.geojson 'https://services.arcgis.com/8Pc9XBTAsYuxx9Ny/arcgis/rest/services/CountyParkBoundaries_PROS_View_for_ALWAYS_ON/FeatureServer/1/query?outFields=*&where=1%3D1&spatialRefId=4326&f=geojson' 2>&1

# load into postGIS with:
ogr2ogr -lco GEOMETRY_NAME=geom -f PostgreSQL PG:"<postgres connection>" download/mdc_county_park_boundaries.geojson -nlt multipolygon -nln mdc_county_park_boundaries
echo success: mdc_county_park_boundaries.geojson loaded with ogr2ogr


#########
# Step 2 - SQL script (pseudo code):
####

# remove duplicate points and make geometries valid:
UPDATE mdc_county_park_boundaries
  SET geom=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(geom));

# add local geometry column and reproject existing geometries into local EPSG:
ALTER TABLE mdc_county_park_boundaries DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS geom_local CASCADE;
SELECT AddGeometryColumn (
  'mdc_county_park_boundaries',
  'geom_local', 2236, 'multipolygon', 2
);
UPDATE mdc_county_park_boundaries
  SET geom_local=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(ST_Transform(ST_Multi(geom),2236)));
CREATE INDEX mdc_county_park_boundaries_geom_local_idx
  ON mdc_county_park_boundaries
  USING GIST (geom_local);
NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
